slug: 2024-11-20 Africa Data Centres expands by 20 megawatts to meet cloud, AI demand

facts.fact: Africa Data Centres (Cassava Technologies) operates three data centre facilities in Midrand, Centurion and Cape Town serving hundreds of clients including cloud providers, banks and hyperscalers, totalling 30MW before a 20MW expansion to 50MW; the article gives no opening dates, so as_of is its publication date.
